Pregnancy in which the conceptus implants either outside the uterus (fallopian tube, ovary or abdominal cavity) or in an abnormal position within the uterus (cornua, cervix, angular and rudimentary horn). The most common surgical emergency in women in many developing countries
A substantial cause of maternal mortality due to:
- Rapidity with which haemorrhage and shock occur
- Pre-rupture diagnosis is elusive, with consequent delay in surgical management
